description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called ScreenIndexPage, which displays a navigable index of all registered screen assets in the app. It imports Flutter material components and a main.dart file to access the app's screenAssets map.

classes.name: ScreenIndexPage
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds a Scaffold containing a list view of all screen routes from the app's assets, allowing navigation to each.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ScreenIndexPage, creating a list of route names that can be tapped to navigate to different screens.
